agent-submission.objective: Formalize quantum state space as Hilbert lattice relations. Map binary amplitude encoding to symbolic unification. Generate quantum fact predicates for holographic projection.

inputs.input: Pauli X, Y, Z; Hadamard H; CNOT(c,t); Phase(θ); T-gate

facts.fact: qubit(0, alpha, 1.0), qubit(0, beta, 0.0) | qubit(1, alpha, 0.0), qubit(1, beta, 1.0)
superposition(Q, A, B, Phase) :- qubit(Q, alpha, A), qubit(Q, beta, B), phase(Q, Phase)
entangled(Q1, Q2, Correlation) :- qubit(Q1, alpha, A1), qubit(Q2, alpha, A2), Correlation = (A1 * A2)
hamiltonian(system_0, -0.5 * Z + 0.3 * X) | hamiltonian(system_1, 0.2 * Y - 0.1 * Z)

rule.head: gate_effect(Q, Gate, Q_out)
rule.body: qubit(Q, alpha, A), qubit(Q, beta, B), apply_unitary(Gate, [A,B], [A_new, B_new]), Q_out = qubits(A_new, B_new)

rule.head: measure(Q, Result, Prob)
rule.body: qubit(Q, alpha, A), qubit(Q, beta, B), Prob_0 = (A^2), Prob_1 = (B^2), (Result = 0 ; Result = 1)

rule.head: evolve(S, T, S_out)
rule.body: hamiltonian(S, H), time_step(T, Dt), unitary(exp(-i*H*Dt), U), apply_unitary(U, S, S_out)

rule.head: bell_pair(Q1, Q2)
rule.body: qubit(Q1, alpha, 0.707), qubit(Q1, beta, 0.707), qubit(Q2, alpha, 0.707), qubit(Q2, beta, -0.707), entangled(Q1, Q2, -1.0)

constraints.constraint: :- qubit(Q, alpha, A), qubit(Q, beta, B), Norm is sqrt(A^2 + B^2), Norm \= 1.0.
:- apply_unitary(Gate, In, Out), not is_unitary_preserving(Gate, In, Out).
:- copy_qubit(Q1, Q2), Q1 \= Q2, qubit(Q1, alpha, A), qubit(Q2, alpha, A).

proof-obligations.obligation: All quantum states must be normalized: |α|² + |β|² = 1
All gate applications must preserve norm (unitary constraint)
No quantum state may be copied (no-cloning theorem)

kernel-candidates.kernel: state_vector(Q, [Alpha, Beta]) :- qubit(Q, alpha, Alpha), qubit(Q, beta, Beta), Norm is sqrt(Alpha^2 + Beta^2), Norm =:= 1.0.
density_matrix(Q, [[A2, AB_conj], [AB, B2]]) :- state_vector(Q, [A, B]), A2 is A * conj(A), B2 is B * conj(B), AB is A * conj(B), AB_conj is conj(A) * B.
trace_distance(Rho1, Rho2, D) :- eigenvalues(Rho1 - Rho2, Lambdas), sum_abs(Lambdas, SumAbs), D is SumAbs / 2.
fidelity(Rho1, Rho2, F) :- density_matrix(Rho1, M1), density_matrix(Rho2, M2), matrix_sqrt(M1, SqrtM1), trace(SqrtM1 * M2 * SqrtM1, Tr), F is trace(Tr) ^ 2.
